{{location disambiguation 2|The Great Northern Wall|landmark=Great Northern Wall}} {{Mission infobox | name = The Great Northern Wall | campaign = Prophecies | region = Ascalon | type = Cooperative | partysize = 4 | duration = Medium | preceded by = [[Defend the Wall]] | followed by = [[Fort Ranik]] }} It has been too quiet lately. Go past the wall and find [[Bonfaaz Burntfur|Bonfaaz]] and his army. Try to find out what they are up to. == Mission information == ===Requirements=== Any character can simply walk into the outpost from [[Ascalon City]] and start the mission. === Objectives === Scout for Bonfaaz Burntfur's [[Charr]] forces. * Search north of the [[Great Northern Wall|Wall]] to find the Charr army. * Report your findings to [[Captain Calhaan]]. * ADDED: Find a new way back. Run to the Wall. * *[[Bonus|BONUS]]* Recover the four pieces of [[Kilnn Testibrie]]'s [[armor]] and return them to his tomb. === Rewards === {{Template:Mission rewards|Prophecies}} :* Non-[[Prophecies]] [[character]]s will not receive any reward for completing this mission on [[normal mode]]. == Walkthrough == *Talk to Captain Calhaan to open the first gate. *Head outside the gate and travel to the northwest. Eventually you will reach a gate, opened by the [[lever]] next to it. *Continue along the path to a fork, where you will see a pile of [[wreckage]]. Interact with this and pick up [[Kilnn Testibrie's Crest]] - all 4 pieces of his armor are needed for the bonus. *Follow the eastern path to another pile of wreckage, where you will find [[Kilnn Testibrie's Cuisse|Cuisse]]. *To the north, a large group of [[Gargoyle]]s is fighting some Grawl. You can wait until the fight is over, attack immediately, ''or'' simply run past them. If you run past, beware that the [[Shatter Gargoyle]]s have [[Imagined Burden]], and in Hard Mode, [[Crippling Anguish]]. *After the bridge, take the left path to find [[Kilnn Testibrie's Greaves|Greaves]]. Then turn back and head north-east to find [[Kilnn Testibrie's Pauldron|Pauldron]]. Continue along this path to meet [[Kilnn Testibrie]], and give him his armor to complete the bonus. *Return to the south-west path, and after a group of Charr with a boss, there is a [[cinematic]]. After the cinematic many Charr will be chasing you. Run south to the wall and inform (talk to) the Captain of the incoming invasion. Do not stop at all along the way, or you will be giving the Charr time to catch up to you. If the Charr do get close, just keep running - only one player needs to reach the Captain. === Hard mode === Skip the cinematic and use a movement speed increasing skill (such as [[Fall Back!]]) or a speed boost [[consumable]]. In [[hard mode]] enemies move 33-50% faster, so with default running speed the second group of Charr catches up with you before you reach the soldiers. If you run with heroes/henchmen, flag them in the path of the Charr so that their sacrifice can earn you a bit more time. == Interactive objects == * Lever (used to operate the first gate). * Lever (used by the Charr to open the second gate). * Wreckage. == NPCs == === Allies === [[Human]]s ([[Ascalon Army]]) * {{w}} 6 (20) [[Captain Calhaan]] * {{w}}{{r}} 5 (20) [[Ascalon Veteran]] [[Ghost]] * {{w}} 15 (20) [[Kilnn Testibrie]] === Charmable animals === [[Animal]]s * {{x}} 3 (3) [[Moa Bird]] === Foes === [[Charr]] * {{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Axe Fiend]] * {{w}} 6 (23) [[Charr Axe Warrior]] * {{w}} 8 (23) [[Charr Blade Storm]] * {{w}} 5, 6 (23) [[Charr Blade Warrior]] * {{w}} 6, 8 (23) [[Charr Scout]] * {{r}} 8 (23) [[Charr Hunter]] * {{r}} 5, 6 (23) [[Charr Stalker]] * {{mo}} 7 (23) [[Charr Shaman]] * {{n}} 8 (23) [[Charr Ashen Claw]] [[Devourer]]s * {{w}} 4 (22) [[Carrion Devourer]] * {{r}} 4 (22) [[Whiptail Devourer]] * {{n}} 3 (22) [[Plague Devourer]] [[Gargoyle]]s * {{me}} 4 (22) [[Shatter Gargoyle]] * {{e}} 3 (22) [[Flash Gargoyle]] [[Grawl]]s * {{w}} 4 (22) [[Grawl (Ascalon)|Grawl]] * {{mo}} 3 (22) [[Grawl Ulodyte]] ==== Bosses ==== [[Charr]] * {{w}} 7 (26) [[Drub Gorefang]] * {{r}} 7 (26) [[Slur Scarchest]] * {{mo}} 7 (26) [[Swag the Lasher]] * {{n}} 7 (26) [[Maul Riptear]] * {{me}} 7 (26) [[Marr Burnhorn]] * {{e}} 7 (26) [[Fume Kindleflail]] * {{e}} 10 (27) [[Bonfaaz Burntfur]]1 [[Devourer]]s * {{r}} 6 (26) [[Igg Fecpelter]] * {{n}} 6 (26) [[Fleck Grokspit]] [[Gargoyle]]s * {{me}} 6 (26) [[Spazz Mindrender]] * {{e}} 6 (26) [[Claw Fleshfixer]] [[Grawl]]s * {{w}} 6 (26) [[Onaona Kubkub]] * {{mo}} 6 (26) [[Makani Ookook]]
1 Bonfaaz Burntfur can be seen in the first cinematic and when the cinematic is skipped, but will be removed from the game when the Charr advance towards the wall. == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"We fear the Charr General Bonfaaz Burntfur is planning a mass raid on the Wall."'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"Head north into enemy territory and find out what that mangy beast has planned."'' : '''Ascalon Veteran:''' ''"It's been awfully quiet around here. No Charr patrols for days."'' : '''Ascalon Veteran:''' ''"Yeah. It's eerie. Everyone's on edge."'' : '''Ascalon Veteran:''' ''"I don't think Ascalon could hold back another Charr invasion."'' : '''Ascalon Veteran:''' ''"They're planning something, I know it."'' === Intermediate dialogue === When talking to Kilnn Testibrie the first time. : '''Kilnn Testibrie:''' ''"In life, I was known as the Champion of [[Surmia]]. In death I am but a restless spirit."'' : '''Kilnn Testibrie:''' ''"Please help me. The enchanted armor that sealed my tomb has been stolen."'' : '''Kilnn Testibrie:''' ''"Find it and return it to me, so that I may pass into [[the Rift]]."'' After returning all four pieces to him. : '''Kilnn Testibrie:''' ''"Thank you!"'' : '''Kilnn Testibrie:''' ''"I will remember your kindness when we meet again in [[the Underworld]]."'' === Intermediate cinematic === {{more|The Great Northern Wall (cinematics)}} :''':''' ''"The Charr invasion force. Captain Calhaan was right.'' :''':''' ''They've spotted us. Back to the Wall!"'' === End cinematic === : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"You're back. Well done. What news of the Charr?"'' : ''':''' ''"We found Bonfaaz Burntfur and the Charr army, sir, in a valley to the north."'' : ''':''' ''"But I'm afraid we were spotted. They come for the Wall as we speak!"'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"There are too many. We'll never hold them back."'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"The Wall is lost. We must fall back."'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"Retreat! Retreat!"'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"Regroup at the bunkers just north of Fort Ranik."'' : '''Captain Calhaan:''' ''"We can't let the Charr make it to the [[Rin|capital]]."'' == Notes == * After completing this mission, the party will appear in [[Fort Ranik (outpost)|Fort Ranik]]. * Purple-pink waterish liquid inflicts negative environmental effect [[Tar]]. * After the first cinematic, take care to stay on the correct path (i.e. the bridges). If by choosing the wrong one, you will not know until you are just opposite the gate, and by then, it is too late - the Charr will have beaten you there. * Unlike other quest items, Testibrie's items can be salvaged and sold. * Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #2 of the [[Young Heroes of Tyria]] [[storybook]]. ;[[Running]] * Since no foes are required to be killed, this mission and the bonus can be completed by [[running]]. ** High-[[level]] parties can fight through the mob of Charr instead of running; however, the mission timer will still tick down and eventually kill the party, thus having failed the mission. ;[[Cartography]] * Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 0.9% to the [[Cartographer]] title. ** Players can uncover large areas of the map by heading towards the source of Charr instead of running from them. There are two sections, north and west. *** To reach the northern area run past the attacking Charr after the cinematic. The area behind them is easy to explore. *** To reach the western area follow the mission path after the cinematic until you see a group of Charr running towards you from the right. Follow that path. It will lead you to uncover a large southwestern area of the map. A running skill or a speed boost, ie. red rock candy, etc. is recommended for finishing this section on the first try.
